title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
abstract: arXiv:2611.31055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spann

translated_title: CAST：一种已部署的面向娱乐电视隐藏式字幕的语音转文本级联系统
translated_abstract: 尽管自动语音识别（ASR）进展迅速，但对于音乐与音效密集、口音丰富、存在串音和噪声的长篇娱乐视频而言，字幕生成仍然具有挑战性。转录文本的质量不仅取决于声学模型，也同样取决于分割及周边模块。单次语音活动检测（VAD）可能漏掉微弱的低能量语音，同时将近乎静音的片段传递给自回归解码器，从而引发幻觉和重复输出。这些相互冲突的错误促使我们设计了一种分层VAD，它会在语义与声学保留性检查下重新审视被拒绝的片段。我们提出了电视字幕ASR堆栈（CAST），这是一个用于隐藏式字幕（CC）的集成语音转文本流水线，它将冻结的Whisper large-v3与分割、语言识别、歌词路由以及针对性的幻觉检测与修复相结合，并在单块NVIDIA L4 GPU上运行。在100个内部资产上……
tldr: 本文提出并实际部署了CAST电视隐藏式字幕语音转文本级联系统，其核心创新在于采用分层语音活动检测（通过语义与声学保留检查重审被拒片段，以捕获微弱语音并抑制静音引发的幻觉与重复），并将冻结的Whisper large-v3与分割、语言识别、歌词路由及针对性幻觉检测修复集成于单块NVIDIA L4 GPU之上。
en_tdlr: CAST is a deployed speech-to-text cascade for entertainment TV closed captioning whose key innovation is a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks to catch faint speech and curb hallucination, integrated with frozen Whisper large-v3, segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU.
